_activity: Build it: bring what you know
_licence: ORIGINAL, built on the 11.2 casefile documents (numbered per the signed 11.2 map). Quotes are the casefile's adapted text.
intro: Build the sentence. Drag the correct piece into each blank.
sentence_frame: Document ___ doesn't say it, but ___, which helps explain ___.

tiles.text: Shays' Rebellion in 1786–87 showed Congress had no army to keep order
each state had one vote in Congress
the Stamp Act was repealed in 1766
why leaders wrote the Constitution in 1787
why the colonists boycotted British goods

correct_sentence: Document 11 doesn't say it, but Shays' Rebellion in 1786–87 showed Congress had no army to keep order, which helps explain why leaders wrote the Constitution in 1787.
rationale: Outside evidence is a fact that isn't in the document. “Each state had one vote” is in Document 11, so it doesn't count.
hints: Which document is the Articles of Confederation?
Which fact is outside the Articles and explains what came next?
